headline: Warden Work Yields in Weathered Expanse; Kuura Strand Quiets
war_summary: Since the last edition the Warden line in the Weathered Expanse has yielded another work to no-man's-land, leaving three Warden, three Colonial and three unclaimed, though the day's fury about Spirit Watch and Frostmarch has cooled from fourteen actions in two hours to two, with sixty-one logged across the day and losses of 6,916 Colonial against 8,498 Warden in twenty-four hours. Kuura Strand, lately turned Colonial, has fallen silent — no action recorded in nearly three hours, after 1,173 Colonial and 727 Warden casualties in the day. The Gutter and Marban Hollow have likewise banked their fires. Still burning: Linn Mercy, six actions in two hours about Outwich Ranch; Stlican Shelf at Breaker Town; Pari Peak at Pariah; and Farranac Coast, where Warden troops took Transient Valley and losses run 334 Colonial to 550 Warden in two hours. Olavis Wake reports no captures yet, but 420 Colonial and 419 Warden fell there in two hours, with Stonecradle little lighter. Colonials hold 323 works to the Warden 100, with seven unclaimed.
